files.description: Weekly sales per shop branch (180 rows): branch_code (five-digit branch code written with leading zeros, e.g. "01005"; 12 different branches, each appearing in many rows), week (week number 1-15), sales (units sold, whole number; about 3% of cells are empty).

task_text: Total the sales of each branch over all weeks. The branch codes must keep their leading zeros exactly as written in the file (for example '01005'). There are only a few distinct branches, so read the branch code as a categorical column. `result` should be a Series indexed by branch code with the total sales.
intended_computation: Read branch_code as text labels (12 branches, codes with leading zeros), sum sales per branch (missing sales ignored) and return the totals indexed by the code text.

acceptable_variants.notes: totals may be integers or floats.

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.1 reading the codes as categories infers integer categories, so the leading zeros are lost

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
